summary: A toggle for a single on/off setting that takes effect as a value of a form: a native checkbox with the switch role, drawn as a track and a sliding thumb, with a built-in label, description and error message, in two sizes. It is form-associated: it submits its value while on, resets with its form, follows a disabled fieldset and validates required.

checked.note: On or off (registered alias of selected). The attribute is the default state that form.reset() restores; the property is the live state and is not reflected, as on a native checkbox (Q1, Q5).

value.note: Submitted under name while checked; nothing is submitted while off. Default 'on', as a native checkbox.

name.note: The name the value is submitted under (FormAssociated mixin). Empty: the switch is not submitted.

disabled.note: Not focusable, not operable, not submitted, barred from validation (FormAssociated mixin). A <fieldset disabled> ancestor has the same effect without touching this attribute.

required.note: The switch must be on for the form to be valid: unchecked gives the native valueMissing on the inner input, mirrored to the host (FormAssociated mixin).

label.note: Visible text beside the track and the accessible name of the switch (NativeControl mixin). Empty: a console warning (missingNameWarning).

description.note: A hint shown under the label and read as the switch's description (aria-describedby) (NativeControl mixin).

errorMessage.note: Why the value is not accepted. Shown under the description, and added to the description, only while validation is error.

validation.note: error shows the error look and the errorMessage and sets aria-invalid on the inner input. It does not change the form validity; that comes from required (Q4).

size.note: The track and thumb size step; the text keeps the body size in both (Q7).

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.notes: A <label> wrapping the control and the text, so a click anywhere on the row toggles. Lays the track and the text column out in a row, track first.

anatomy.name: input
anatomy.notes: Native <input type=checkbox role=switch>, the focus target and validation anchor. Visually hidden over the track, never display:none.

anatomy.name: track
anatomy.notes: The pill the thumb slides in; filled by state (off, on), outlined in destructive while validation is error. Decorative (aria-hidden).

anatomy.name: thumb
anatomy.notes: The round knob: at the inline start when off, at the inline end when on (mirrored in RTL).

anatomy.name: text
anatomy.notes: Column holding label, description and error message. Not rendered when all three are empty.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.notes: Visible label text; the wrapping <label> makes it the input's accessible name.

anatomy.name: description
anatomy.notes: Visible description, aria-hidden; the mixin's hidden description node is the aria-describedby target so it is read once (Q6).

anatomy.name: error
anatomy.notes: Rendered only while validation is error and errorMessage is not empty; referenced by aria-describedby after the description.

change.note: After the user toggles (click, Space, label activation). The native change is not composed, so the host re-dispatches it (NativeControl mixin); the form value is already synced when it fires. Not fired for programmatic checked changes or form.reset().

input.note: The inner input's native input event, composed by the platform, retargeted to the host. Fires before change on each user toggle.

hover.trigger: Pointer over the row (not when disabled).
hover.note: No look change, as in the visual reference; the cursor is pointer.

focus-visible.trigger: Keyboard focus on the inner input; exposed on the host as :state(focus-visible).
focus-visible.note: Ring around the track, not around the text.

checked.note: The thumb slides to the inline end over switch.thumb.transition-duration; no transition under prefers-reduced-motion (Q9).

disabled.trigger: disabled, or a <fieldset disabled> ancestor (host matches :disabled).
disabled.note: The whole row dims; cursor not-allowed. Styled with :host(:disabled), never :host([disabled]).

invalid.note: Track outlined in destructive; errorMessage shown. A required, unchecked switch is natively invalid (:invalid) without this look until the author sets validation (Q4).

accessibility.native: <input type="checkbox" role="switch"> inside the shadow root, wrapped by a <label>
accessibility.accessibleNameSource: label prop, rendered as the text of the <label> that wraps the inner input. A <label for> pointing at the host activates it but does not name it.

formAssociation.note: FormAssociated(NativeControl(LitElement)). formValue(): value while checked, else null. formReset(): checked = hasAttribute('checked'). formStateRestore(state): checked = state === value. validationAnchor(): the inner input (required -> valueMissing). syncFormState() runs in the change handler before change is re-dispatched. Inner input gets ?disabled=${isDisabled} and ?required=${required}, no name.

accessibility.targetSize: The whole row (track and label) is the target and is at least switch.root.min-height (24px) tall, so the small track (24x16) still meets WCAG 2.5.8 (Q8).
accessibility.focusRingVisible: switch.focus-ring.width ring in switch.focus-ring.color around the track on :focus-visible of the inner input; 3:1 against the background (WCAG 2.4.7, 2.4.13).
accessibility.missingNameWarning: console.warn once when label is empty (NativeControl mixin).

keyboard.Tab: Moves focus to and from the switch (one tab stop). Skipped while disabled.
keyboard.Space: Toggles checked, fires input and change.
keyboard.Enter: Does not toggle; submits the owning form, as a native checkbox does (Q2).

aria: role=switch on the inner input; the checked state is exposed natively (aria-checked is not set by hand).
aria-describedby on the inner input lists the description node, then the error node while validation is error and errorMessage is not empty.
aria-invalid=true on the inner input while validation is error; absent otherwise.
The track, thumb and visible description copy are aria-hidden.
required and disabled are native attributes on the inner input (exposed as required and disabled).
announcements: On focus: label, 'switch', on/off, then description and error message.
On toggle: the new state (on/off), from the native role; no live region.

useCases.when: A single setting that is on or off, such as enabling notifications in a settings form.
A setting the form cannot be sent without, such as accepting terms.
useCases.use: <sb-switch name="terms" required label="Accept the terms" validation="error" error-message="You must accept the terms."></sb-switch>

antiPatterns.why: The switch has no accessible name (WAI-ARIA APG Switch pattern: a switch must have a label; WCAG 4.1.2).

antiPatterns.pattern: Setting aria-checked or role on the host.
antiPatterns.why: The role and state live on the inner native input; a second set on the host duplicates or contradicts them (APG: prefer native semantics).
antiPatterns.alternative: Use checked; the inner input exposes the state.

drift.contract: Medium track 32x20, small 24x16 (size.switch.*); thumbs 16 and 12 with a 2px inset.
drift.realization: shadcn/ui: default track 32x18.4 (1.15rem), small 24x14; whole-pixel sizes on the 4px grid here.
shadcn/ui uses a lighter input color that fails WCAG 1.4.11; the semantic token is already darkened (D-001).

drift.contract: Built into the switch as props and parts.
drift.realization: shadcn/ui composes a separate Label and Field around the switch.
shadcn/ui: ring color at 50% opacity, which fails 3:1.
shadcn/ui renders a <button role=switch> plus a hidden input.

openQuestions.question: Contract content drafted with the contract-author skill (visual reference, WAI-ARIA APG)?
openQuestions.answer: Yes: API and look from the visual reference, keyboard and roles from the APG Switch pattern, form behavior from the form-associated-controls rule.

openQuestions.question: Name the on/off prop checked or the canonical selected?
openQuestions.recommendation: checked: the registered alias, the name of the native property and of the reference API, and what framework bindings expect.
openQuestions.answer: checked (recommended; no reviewer available in the session).

openQuestions.question: Should Enter toggle the switch (APG lists it as optional)?
openQuestions.recommendation: No: Space toggles; Enter submits the owning form, as a native checkbox does, through the NativeControl implicit submit.

openQuestions.question: Inner element: <input type=checkbox role=switch> or <button role=switch>?
openQuestions.recommendation: The checkbox input: native validity (valueMissing), label activation and checked state come free, and it is the validation anchor the mixins expect.

openQuestions.question: Does validation=error change the form validity, and does a required, unchecked switch show the error look by itself?
openQuestions.recommendation: No to both: validity comes only from required (native valueMissing, browser message, reportValidity focuses the input); validation and errorMessage are the author's presentation, set from their own validation timing.
openQuestions.answer: validation is presentational plus aria-invalid; native validity is from required only (recommended).

openQuestions.question: What does form.reset() restore, and is checked reflected?
openQuestions.recommendation: The checked attribute is the default (like defaultChecked); the property is live and not reflected; reset sets checked = hasAttribute('checked') without firing change.

openQuestions.question: The NativeControl description node is hidden; how is the description both visible and read once?
openQuestions.recommendation: Render renderDescription() as the aria-describedby target and a visible aria-hidden copy in the description part; no change to the shared mixin.

openQuestions.question: Which two sizes?
openQuestions.recommendation: small and medium (default) from the size vocabulary, mapping the reference's sm and default.

openQuestions.question: The small track is 16px tall, under the 24px target of WCAG 2.5.8. Grow it?
openQuestions.recommendation: Keep the track; make the whole row the target (wrapping <label>) with min-block-size switch.root.min-height (24px).

openQuestions.question: Animate the thumb?
openQuestions.recommendation: Yes, transform over motion.duration.fast with the standard easing; no transition under prefers-reduced-motion.

openQuestions.question: Add a label-position prop or a hidden-label option?
openQuestions.recommendation: No (not requested): the track comes first and the text after; revisit when a layout needs it.
